decisions.reason: As a newly launched product line that is very close to the firm's core dental software business and fits the push toward digital, connected practice workflows, it is likely to stay because a growing firm with R&D and broad offerings has enough slack to continue it absent clear signs of failure.

The education institute is somewhat more peripheral than core software but still builds on the firm's training resources and customer relationships, so with firm growth and no clear evidence of underperformance management would more likely retain it than redeploy resources immediately.

The remote screen sharing support tool supports the established service offering and customer support capabilities, and although it may be less distinctive than the other launches, the firm's slack and lack of a visible shortfall make keeping it the more likely choice for now.
